scripts.format: prettier --write cli/src cli/test cli/scripts/*.ts cli/README.md server shared web test scripts *.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check cli/src cli/test cli/scripts/*.ts cli/README.md server shared web test scripts *.json README.md
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run format:check
scripts.build:bin:host: bun run --cwd cli build:bin:host && bun run --cwd server build:bin:host
